[h3]"Only bugs can truly appreciate the beauty of flowers" ~ Dov Davidoff[/h3]

[h2]FIXED[/h2]

- placing souvenirs inside stands in the museum
- souvenir not disappearing when exiting from stand menu while an object is in an invalid position
- issue with belt grabbing random objects in Warehouse
- issue with missing translation in the tutorial
- touch working with disabled button in arm menu
- pressing infinitely on Lamp and other usable
- tablet now summons after each step in the tutorial
- changed outline colors when an object is highlighted with prior elements still mounted to avoid confusion
- made steps backward compatible in the tutorial
- screws in PZKPFW III Ausf J fixed

- museum bug with grabbed souvenirs and exiting menu while placing

notes.title: Update 1.01 "FIRST AID" 🩹
notes.content:
[h1][b]IT'S ALIVE![/b][/h1]

Yes, the first update is coming with the speed of light. We are working very hard to fix all reported bugs. So here it is "the first aid" to the game. We are very thankful for your commitment. We can promise to support the game and players to give you the best tank mechanic experience 💪. 
The first patch will fix issues with the tablet, height adjustment for seated users, and tank steering.

notes.title: PLAYTEST UPDATE #3
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40222244/de282171788975d4e2d1b4840f6eb1b129eae61d.png[/img]

Hello mechanics! 🧰 🛠️ 🎮

As you all keep playing and testing the game, we are doing our best to solve any issue you run into. Once again we would like to express how much all your feedback means to us! It already allowed us to prepare third update ✅ 👍🏽

That is why we prepared 2 forms which we believe will be helpful both for you and for us:

1. [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1J6zi5wcmHeUxJqnpy0kQZSzSiieBEW5xLhUijc-Xuzc/]BUG REPORT FORM[/url]

2. [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1R8SaTpYtPTJqMBV6asvmuyfpuweQQfyaJBuWv1i--gE/]PLAYTEST SURVEY[/url]
 
Please feel free to use them both for bugs reporting and to share your insights and suggestions with us!

And here's the list of today's changes in the Playtest:

[list]
[*] New Lighting system
[*] Improved FPS for most setups with SinglePass rendering.
[*] Fixed the bug causing Red Platform not appearing in come cases
[*] Improved Outline for elements and tools, lines are sharper now and do not overlay on each other
[*] Grinder tool fixes
[*] Test Track collisions fixed
[*] Game freezing in Warehouse fixed
[*] Using laser, Grab and Wrench Tool on Screw will not speed up the process anymore
[*] Fixed paintable textures on tank
[*] Tablet automatic hand laser is fixed for both Tablet and Keyboard
[*] Screw grab mechanics fixed
[*] Resolved issue with duplicated parts when grabbed in a specific way
[*] Improved switching between dissassemble and assemble modes
[*] Screws textures now look the way they should on elements
[/list]

notes.title: PLAYTEST UPDATE!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40222244/de282171788975d4e2d1b4840f6eb1b129eae61d.png[/img]

Hello mechanics! 🧰 🛠️ 🎮

Your invaluable feedback allowed us to introduce first set of fixes and improvements in the Tank Mechanic Simulator VR Playtest. You all have done a great job finding bugs and sharing your suggestions with us. Thank you for that! ✅ 👍🏽

Below you will find a list of changes in today's update:


[list]
[*] Fixed tank elements passing through geometry of warehouse.
[*] Fixed the Adjust Position option which in some cases did not appear while entering Tank for the first time.
[*] Fixed cost and sell values of drive parts.
[*] Fixed elements which looked dirty after being repaired/bought from the shop.
[*] Fixed chair having slow fall physics.
[*] Small fixes to Tablet screen keyboard for some languages.
[*] Fixed Tank not switching from examine/interior mode when being transfered to Paint Room.
[*] Corrected walking in TestDrive area.
[*] Fixed parts duplication when grabbing the screw.
[*] Fixes in translations.
[*] Improved detection of player on Stairs nearby tank.
[*] Black dots in paintroom removed.
[/list]
